name: Swan River
blurb: Quiet valley float into Bigfork. Take out above the Wild Mile unless you meant to run Class III.

sections.notes: Mellow until town. The Wild Mile gorge at Bigfork is a separate Class III run — don't float into it by accident.
sections.accessReview: A usable take-out above the Wild Mile has not been confirmed. The mapped Bigfork boat ramp is a different location and must not be substituted. This section is not ready for trip planning.
sections.mapPendingReason: A usable take-out above the Wild Mile has not been confirmed. The mapped Bigfork boat ramp is a different location and must not be substituted. This section is not ready for trip planning.

mapAuditNote: Audited 2026-10-24. The current FWP Swan River site is downstream near Ferndale and the FWP Bigfork ramp is beyond the catalog’s “above the Wild Mile” endpoint. Those records do not safely identify this section’s intended launch and take-out, so the map remains hidden.
